title: Venus May Be Hiding Evidence of Ancient Water in Its Rocks, Scientists Discover
description: New NASA experiments reveal how Venus' extreme atmosphere could preserve mineral evidence of ancient water and offer clues to ongoing volcanic activity.

title: Babies in ancient Greek colony started solid food at 3 months but nursed for nearly 4 years, chemical signatures suggest
description: Over 2,500 years ago, Himera was a Greek colony inhabited by local Sicilians, Phoenicians and Greeks. Despite their diverse cultural backgrounds, they all shared one thing: they began weaning their babies early and continued for a long time.

title: UN climate talk negotiators go into second day of overtime while at odds over fossil fuels
description: Negotiators at the United Nations climate talks have entered a second extra day in attempt to reach a final agreement to address global warming. The annual summit in the coastal city of Antalya, Turkey, called COP31, was supposed to end Friday. Turkish environment minister Murat Kurum, president of the talks, said early Sunday that he had “a text which all parties can agree to.” The text was not immediately made public. Key issues have bogged down the negotiations including the amount of concerted effort by countries to wean themselves from fossil fuels such as coal, oil and gas, which are the main drivers of climate change, and whether ramping up electricity should only be done with renewables. title: SCO Civilisational Dialogue: PM Modi calls ancient civilizations to reunite, revive ties and build a safer future
description: Presently Purana Qila of New Delhi is hosting SCO Civilization Dialogue Forum. Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the inaugural session. The PM stated, “It’s high time for all the ancient civilizations of the world to realise and rejuvenate their old ties and come together to lead the world to a better, safer tomorrow”. But do the ancient civilizations which PM talks about exist? We need to ponder on this question. The ancient world had very few civilizations which includes the great Saraswati Sindhu civilization, Mesopotamia and few more. We need to keep in mind that Pakistan too is part of the SCO Summit, because the age old Saraswati Sindhu Civilization which is now divided between Bharat and Pakistan was one 4500 years ago. Pakistan’s Harappa followed the same norms, ritual and laws of the day as Bharat’s Dholavira in Gujarat and Rakhigarhi in Haryana. Both countries were part of the same cultural and civilizational family. Today Pakistan need to remember that it was the ancestors in Sindu Saraswathi civilisation, who created the world’s most advanced civilization. The case of Iran As far as Iran is concerned, we know that the Iranian text Avesta’s Vendidad states that the Aryans living on the banks of the Saraswati and Sindhu came to Iran and settled there. Bharat has had a long trade relationship with Iran since that time. That’s not all, Avesta also describes the geography of ancient Bharat. This seals the 4000 years old relationship between two countries and the fact that cross border commute was a general practice. Also Read: Poland reports Russian missiles near European drills; NATO calls incident ‘grave’ as military tensions take a new turn Relations with Mesopotamia The Mesopotamia civilization that the Prime Minister talked about was very far yet very close to Bharatiya civilization and business transactions were the backbone of this co-dependent age-old bond. The traders of the Saraswati Sindhu civilization used to ship cloths, elephant tusk products, gems etc. to Mesopotamia and merchants from there used to sell their antiquities like arsenic free copper in cities of Saraswati Sindhu Civilization. The business and cultural ties were so strong that traders of the Saraswati Sindhu Civilization set up their permanent settlements in Mesopotamia. It’s no shock that Bharatiya merchants had no problem staying there and conducting their business. These ties bestowed equal opportunities of growth and development to both the civilizations. These relationships made both the civilizations prosperous during the proto historic time period. The ancient partnership with China Today’s China poses significant geopolitical challenge for India. However, during ancient times they infact have been partners for centuries. Chinese travellers like huyesangh and fahyaan visited Bharat, earned knowledge, wrote about the civilization and went back to their nation. Bharatiya merchants too safely visited China so much so that they comfortably set up hindu deity Shiv ji’s temples across china in 6th century. This goes on to show that relations were very cordial. Civilisational ties with Central Asia The Central Asian country Tajakistan which is also a part of SCO had a deep relationship with Bharat since ancient times. The BMAC culture known as Bactria Margiana Archaeological Complex also holds trade relations with Saraswati Civilization. Sites of the civilization like Gonurdepe and Altyndepe have turned up seals of Saraswati civilization, the seals have elephant motifs and Saraswati script. Unearthing of Ivory objects made by Bhartiya craftsmen confirms the healthy trade relation with ancient civilization of Tajikistan. In today’s changing and challenging times, it is very important that these countries who have been historically and culturally allied with India for thousands of years, remembers it and comes together. Our ancestors established friendly ties and led the world to a better place and the SCO Civilizational Dialogue forum is believed to do the same. Through SCO Civilisational Dialogue, India aims to ensure harmony among the nations. The relationship between these ancient civilizations is an unmistakable evidence of “Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam” which cannot be erased.
